messages:
nina: Heads-up: scheduling a targeted cross-service canary in tonight's 00:30 UTC change window. Scope: api, runtime, router, console agent. Small traffic slice (~2%).

raj: Quick question: router pin hard or soft? Router affinity change could obscure canary signal if not pinned.

tara: We saw session-affinity regressions last time when router went mixed. Recommend router pin hard for first 12m then relax to soft for observation.

mike: Console wants to remain unpinned so UX shows errors across variants. But we can agree console agent pinned only during initial smoke.

nina: Proposed plan: Phase 0 (0-5m) smoke: pin all services hard. Phase 1 (5-12m) keep router/runtime pinned hard, api soft pinned, console unpin. Phase 2 (12-30m) router soft, api soft, runtime keep pinned unless safe.

raj: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback on 3m sustained p95 +250ms vs baseline OR error-rate climb >0.75% absolute OR business KPI drop >15% over 5m. Soft alerts for cache miss rise >7% 3m.

engops-bot: Preflight: compatibility checks started. Runtime schema OK. API: minor deprecation warnings. Router: OK. Console agent: agent schema mismatch (minor).

mike: I'll cut a quick console agent patch to silence schema warnings. Won't change behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled at 2026-03-24T00:30Z. Wave id: 7991. Targets runtime:v2.2-canary, api:v2.2-canary, router:v2.2-canary, console-agent:v2.2-canary.

nina: Pin commands we'll run:

```
rd-deploy pin --service router --variant v2.2-canary --mode hard --expires 00:12:00
rd-deploy pin --service runtime --variant v2.2-canary --mode hard --expires 00:30:00
rd-deploy pin --service api --variant v2.2-canary --mode soft --expires 00:12:00
rd-deploy pin --service console --variant v2.2-canary --mode hard --expires 00:05:00
```

raj: Confirm flags exist. Also add telemetry checks at 0/3/6/12/20/30m. We'll run a synthetic job hitting sensitive endpoints.

smoke-bot: Smoke-run at 00:20Z: baseline verified across sample endpoints, no errors.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary wave 7991 started. Pins applied.

nina: 0m quick check: p95 +8ms, errors 0.01%, affinity buckets stable.

mike: Console agent patch built -> image sha256:deadbeefcafebabe. Posting digest.

raj: 6m check: p95 +30ms, errors 0.04%, cache misses +2% -> ok. No rollback.

tara: At 12m we're softening router pin to soft as planned. Unpinning router to soft now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router pin updated to mode=soft.

nina: 18m: noticing slight p95 uptick (+60ms) on a specific API path. Investigating with tracing.

raj: Traces point to a new kernel path in runtime that increases tail for long-context requests. I'm opening a hotfix ticket, but metric still below rollback.

nina: Keep monitoring. If p95 goes over +250ms sustained -> rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary wave 7991 completed at 01:00Z. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

nina: Thanks all — I'll draft the release notes with the pin/unpin plan and the observed kernel tail behavior for follow-up. Planning gradual ramp at 03:00 UTC with stage checkpoints every 30m.
